kind_of_no: no web presence (private; no price or presence indicator)
why: 2026-11-12: the City of Kulm page (kulmnd.com/kulm-campgrounds.html) gives only 'Pesek Campground: 701-320-3799'. OSM way 874194294 (edited 2026-04-24) maps it as a ~35 x 35 m sand lot at 46.29768,-98.94912, operator Ben Pesek, fee=yes, reservation recommended, no showers, static_caravans=yes. No website, no posted rate, no booking engine, no RV Life listing, and no Google Maps place (gm.py on 'Pesek Campground Kulm ND' and 'Camp Kulm Kulm ND' both resolve to the city's Kulm Campground, 3.6/8). A private park needs a price indicator AND a presence indicator; it has neither. Nightly vs long-term share, hookups and rig fit are also unknowable from any source.
name: Pesek Campground
waterfront_evidence_if_added: Esri 2021-05-24 and USGS NAIP imagery at 46.29768,-98.94912 (2026-11-12): in-town sand lot between houses and a gravel street, cropland to the south; no water anywhere in frame. Not waterfront by default-down.
flags: Not a duplicate of 5993 Kulm City Campground: Pesek's lot sits west of Kulm Public School (south edge of town, 2nd Ave SW side), ~0.34 km from 5993's pin and ~0.42 km from its pads, which are east of the school by the pool on 3rd Ave SE. Different operator (Ben Pesek vs Kulm Park Board / City of Kulm) and different phone on the city page (701-320-3799 vs 701-269-0014).

Operating: USGS NAIP imagery (the 2023 frame lead 18 cited) shows about five RVs parked side by side on the lot; Esri's 2021-05-24 frame shows it empty (pre-season). OSM's static_caravans=yes plus side-by-side parking suggests long-term/seasonal use, but nothing gives a count.

KCDC question (lead 18) - suggestive, not settled: search snippets of HHS lists show 'CAMP KULM', PO Box 224 Kulm, owner BEN PESEK PROPERTIES LLC, phone 701-320-3799, licensed 5/26/2021 and on a list expiring 12/31/2024 (last inspection 6/11/2024); both PDFs now 404. The 07.17.2025 list (hhs.nd.gov statewide-licensed-rv-parks-campgrounds-exception.pdf, re-read 2026-11-12) has no Camp Kulm/Pesek row, only KCDC PARK (6 Main Ave N, Kulm Community Development Corp., 7 lots, inspected 4/24/2025) and KULM PARK (City of Kulm, 10 lots). Ben Pesek is KCDC's president, Camp Kulm drops off the list the same cycle KCDC Park appears, and the Pesek lot holds roughly 5-7 rigs, so Camp Kulm was most likely relicensed as KCDC PARK. Against that, the city page still lists 'KCDC Campground' (701-647-2878, Kulm Hardware's number) and 'Pesek Campground' separately. Whether the 2024 list also had a KCDC row could not be checked (that PDF 404s). One phone call would settle it.
Ownership if ever added: private (Ben Pesek Properties LLC or the KCDC non-profit). It would then need the price gate, a presence indicator, and long-stay test 4.

Phone-list line: Pesek Campground / Camp Kulm, Kulm ND, 701-320-3799 (Ben Pesek) - Are lots sold by the night to travellers, and how many of the ~7 are nightly vs seasonal/monthly? Nightly rate, hookups/amps, season, longest rig that fits? Is this the lot HHS now licenses as KCDC PARK (Kulm Community Development Corp., 7 lots), and is 'KCDC Campground' (701-647-2878) the same place?
